ticket.title: Add a keyboard shortcut to open the new-ticket modal
ticket.description: Pressing Cmd+N anywhere on the board opens the new-ticket modal for the current board. Esc closes it. The shortcut is shown in the app menu under File > New Ticket. No other shortcuts change.

rubric: The PRD written into the description has a goal, requirements and testable acceptance criteria for the Cmd+N shortcut.
The agent worked without asking the user for confirmation.
The trajectory shows the ticket moved only after the PRD was written, not at the start of the work.
